paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Mean absolute values before and after gating. The baseline and post-gating values are similar.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The figure titled "Hidden State Mean" illustrates changes in the mean absolute values of hidden states across different layers of a model. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22 with evenly spaced numeric intervals. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," also employs a linear scale, starting at 0 and extending to 5, with specific values marked at intervals.

The graph includes three lines, each representing a different condition regarding the hidden state mean. The blue dashed line denotes the hidden state mean before gating, averaging at 0.71. The orange dotted line represents the hidden state mean after gating, with an average of 0.05. Finally, the green solid line indicates the hidden state mean of the baseline, averaging at 0.04. 

The blue dashed line shows relatively stable values with minor fluctuations before layer 20, leading to a noticeable increase at the 22nd layer. The orange dotted line retains a low consistent value throughout, while the green solid line remains close to the baseline level, reflecting minimal change across the layers.
model_annotations.Chinese:
The graph titled "Hidden State Mean" illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across different layers in a neural network architecture, specifically comparing the states before and after gating, along with a baseline. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," employs a linear scale spanning from 0 to 22, indicating the layer numbers. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," represents the absolute mean values, ranging from 0 to 5.

Three distinct lines are plotted in the graph. The blue dashed line represents the "hidden state mean before gate," which starts at approximately 0 at layer 0, gradually increasing to around 0.7 by layer 22. The red dotted line indicates the "hidden state mean after gate," remaining relatively low and stable at approximately 0.05 throughout the layers. Lastly, the green solid line signifies the "hidden state mean of baseline," which maintains a consistent value close to 0.04 across all layers, showing minimal variation. Notably, the most significant increase occurs at the end of the blue dashed line, highlighting a peak before stabilizing.
model_annotations.English: The plot titled "Hidden State Mean" illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across different layers, represented by three distinct lines that reflect various conditions: before gating, after gating, and a baseline measure. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 25, indicating the layer numbers in the model. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean," which measures the absolute mean values, also on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 5. The first line, depicted in blue with a dashed style, represents the hidden state mean before gating, starting at approximately 0.1 at layer 0, gradually increasing to about 0.71 at layer 22. The second line is shown in orange with a dotted style, depicting the hidden state mean after gating, which remains consistently low, starting around 0.05 and finishing around the same value at layer 23. Lastly, the green line represents the hidden state mean of the baseline, shown with a solid style, and remains relatively flat, starting at around 0.04 and finishing slightly above that at layer 23. The plotted data indicate varied behaviors of the hidden states across the layers under different gating conditions.
model_annotations.German:
Das Diagramm zeigt den durchschnittlichen absoluten Wert des versteckten Zustands in Abhängigkeit von der Schicht. Auf der x-Achse ist die Anzahl der Schichten mit der Beschriftung „Layer“ dargestellt, wobei der Wertebereich von 0 bis 22 reicht und die Tick-Beschriftungen mit einer Einheit von 1 angeordnet sind. Die y-Achse zeigt die absoluten Mittelwerte mit der Beschriftung „Abs Mean“, wobei die Werte von 0 bis 5 reichen.

Es gibt drei Linien im Diagramm. Die erste Linie, dargestellt durch eine blaue, gestrichelte Linie, repräsentiert den durchschnittlichen absoluten Wert des versteckten Zustands vor dem Schaltkreis (avg 0.71) und zeigt im Allgemeinen einen Anstieg bis zu einem Wert von etwa 1.5 bei Schicht 22. Die zweite Linie ist durch eine orange, gepunktete Linie gekennzeichnet und stellt den Durchschnitt des versteckten Zustands nach dem Schaltkreis dar (avg 0.05). Diese Linie bleibt nahezu konstant und zeigt nur geringe Schwankungen, die unterhalb von 1 liegen, und endet bei 0.1. Die dritte Linie, dargestellt durch eine grüne, durchgezogene Linie, zeigt den durchschnittlichen absoluten Wert des Basiswerts (avg 0.04) und bleibt ebenfalls nahezu konstant, mit minimalen Schwankungen, die unter 0.1 liegen, und endet bei etwa 0.05.
